topic: warehouse guard must resolve hosts not string-match
lesson: The WAREHOUSE_PG_* separation guard must RESOLVE both the warehouse host and the app pg host via dns.promises.lookup(host,{all:true}) and reject when their resolved IP sets INTERSECT and the ports match (normalize IPv4-mapped ::ffff: and IPv6 loopback). A hand-picked list of loopback spellings + isIP() cannot catch DNS aliases or IPv6-mapped aliases of the app host. This makes loadWarehousePostgresConfig async — make createWarehouseWritePool async and await it in warehouse:migrate/proof and the hermetic test.
